diagnosis.reason: Shrinking the AR window from p=16 to p=8 (all else frozen: diff_order=1, min-max, batch_size=128, epochs=100, lr=0.001) improved target point-wise F1 from 0.7200 to 0.7370 (delta +0.0170). The hypothesis that the differenced curve's exploitable predictive structure is more local than the incumbent's p=16 window is supported; combined with the prior p=32 refutation, the window-vs-F1 relationship is monotone decreasing over {8,16,32}, favoring shorter windows.
